collection.description: A dancer's mask and an old shield from a different household turn out to carry the same painted pattern.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: A dancer's mask and an old shield from a different household turn out to carry the same painted pattern. The two families wonder whether one hand made both, long ago, and begin trading stories.
